texts.en:
Our Grand Archive in [fromfrom.GetName] has been destroyed by [from.GetName].

Unfortunately, we were unable to recover some of our valuable Specimens.
Some of our captive Space Fauna have been released into the wild. Many are in a confused and aggressive state.

We'll need to rebuild the Grand Archive in another system to continue our Specimen exhibitions.

texts.zh:
我们已经摧毁了[from.GetName]所拥有的位于[fromfrom.GetName]内的博物天枢

我们可以从中取回一些有价值的标本。

此外，我们似乎还释放出了一些关在生态园里的太空兽群。很有可能它们会因为刚刚释放而变得既困惑又富有攻击性。
texts.en:
We have destroyed the Grand Archive in [fromfrom.GetName] owned by the [from.GetName].

We were able to recover some of the valuable Specimens inside.

Additionally, we seem to have released some amount of captive Space Fauna from the Vivarium. It's possible they'll be aggressive and confused in their newly released state.

texts.zh:
[from.GetName]所拥有的位于[fromfrom.GetName]内的博物天枢在我们获得该星系后被拆除。

它所占据的空间如今物归原主。
texts.en:
The Grand Archive owned by [from.GetName] in [fromfrom.GetName] has been dismantled upon our acquisition of the system.

The space it occupied has been returned to us.

texts.zh:
我们放弃[from.GetName]后，建于该星系的博物天枢也已被拆除。

所有的标本都得以取回并妥善储藏，以待新的博物天枢建成。
所有的太空兽群都被屠宰转换为基础资源。

我们可以回收建造所使用的大部分合金。如果想继续展览，我们需要在另一个星系完全重建这座建筑。
texts.en:
Our Grand Archive in [from.GetName] has been dismantled upon our abandoning of the system.

All Specimens have been recovered and stored properly until a new Grand Archive can be built.
All Space Fauna have been culled for their base resources.

We have been able to salvage much of the alloys used in its original construction. We will need to rebuild the structure entirely in another system to continue exhibitions.
